title: Engine 4 Tier-1 release list
description: The releases around which Report 2 is not offered (architecture 6.6, ADR-060). The only reader is parseTier1List in lib/engine4/blackout.ts; this file says the same thing for people and editors, and a test keeps the two in step.

listVersion.description: Raised by one whenever the list changes; recorded with a blackout decision.

events.description: Empty ships as 'not set' and fails closed. A list that does not cover every kind also fails closed.

eventId.description: MqlCalendarEvent.id as text (an MQL5 ulong), the key the blackout matches on.

name.description: A label for people; never matched on.
